rules: Strictly forbids tests or fixture operations from modifying cafe.db or unapproved production databases
Permits mutations exclusively on isolated test fixture databases (test/fixtures/*.db or sqlite memory)

test_cases.error_message: MUTATION_GUARD_VIOLATION: [INSERT INTO orders] Attempted mutation on unapproved or production database: "cafe.db". Tests and fixture operations MUST only target isolated fixture databases in test/fixtures/ (e.g., full_day_fixture.db, test_*.db).

MUTATION_GUARD_VIOLATION: [DELETE FROM users] Attempted mutation on unapproved or production database: "cafe.db". Tests and fixture operations MUST only target isolated fixture databases in test/fixtures/ (e.g., full_day_fixture.db, test_*.db).

MUTATION_GUARD_VIOLATION: [UPDATE settings] Attempted mutation on unapproved or production database: "prod_cafe.db". Tests and fixture operations MUST only target isolated fixture databases in test/fixtures/ (e.g., full_day_fixture.db, test_*.db).
